scope: Round 3: the same pinned TTS model on one temporary AWS g5.xlarge (A10G) compared with the WEB CPU host, the closing replayed in a browser and in the AAOS WebView with the GPU request times, and the six wrong-content lines of round 2. Every block names its source. Browser and AAOS closings replay recorded responses with their measured delays; they are not live end-to-end runs. Speed is not audio quality: no listening review is part of this record.
